forecast_cutoff: September 1 China midnight of each origin year
selection: same fixed five companies; original prior-FY annual report first available before cutoff; only explicit issuer annual targets for origin FY; no replacement with broker forecasts, incentive thresholds, later revisions or retrospectively selected reports
semantics: management plan/aspiration is not an unbiased forecast; printed concept and consolidated/parent scope must match actual; revenue differs from total operating income; reported profit is not adjusted EBIT; mixed profit concepts never pooled
targets: primary: explicit point amount of operating revenue or total operating income; secondary: all explicit point reported-profit targets, separately by concept; ranges/lower bounds/non-numeric objectives retained but unscored; percentage targets need matching original base evidence, not later restatements
benchmark: current-rule origin clipped growth applied to known H1 plus prior H2 then FY; zero-growth FY bridge also shown; for each revenue concept use same source concept for H1/H2; profit companion uses matching origin TTM profit/revenue ratio times each revenue forecast; no formula tuning
decision: exposed development study only; failure stops this source-selection rule with no threshold or company tuning; passing only permits untouched validation, never direct DCF adoption; cashflow/reinvestment and multiyear extension remain separate

source_fields.FN74: candidate annual operating revenue CNY; verify against original statement before use
source_fields.FN502: candidate total operating income in 10000 CNY; verify before use
source_fields.FN96: reported parent attributable net profit CNY

boundary: all five companies already exposed; later-acquired TDX/FN314 date proxy not strict PIT; same-company repeated targets not independent; management annual target generally predates H1 benchmark information; no new source-semantic production mapping
